audit.corrected: See edits — phases[N].side moved to match win[N] for rows 0-4, ratings adjusted to match the new verdict.

audit.why: Even skill lane through level 3 around dodging the telegraphed Dazzle, a brief Morgana edge at 4 with Q+W burst before his kit ramps, then Taric takes over from 6 once Cosmic Radiance negates all-ins and his aura heal/stun peel out-value a single root — already stated correctly in content early/mid/late.

Level 6 Cosmic Radiance forcing bait-or-wait play, first item widening Taric's sustain/stun-peel package, and late aura healing plus invuln blunting the pick-and-burst plan are the real spikes and match the kit (R 180/150/120s cooldown, 2.5s pre-cast delay per Riot's text).

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance (R) is 180s at rank 1, 120s maxed — the invuln lands after a 2.5s delay, so burst before it triggers or wait the full duration out. Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed, saved for fights, not chip. The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Dark Binding punishes his short 610 range — land it before he can walk into Dazzle range.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield eats his Dazzle stun relay through Bastion — pool it there, never for a chip-damage trade.
